name: Batman Bridge
connectingPointsDisplay: Whirlpool Reach, Hillwood — Sidmouth / Deviot midpoint
facts: Batman Bridge, Australia's first cable‑stayed bridge, opened in 1968, spanning 206 metres with a 91‑metre‑high steel A‑frame tower that supports 78% of the main span's weight.
Constructed between 1966 and 1968, the bridge's 10.3‑metre‑wide steel deck rests on a dolerite rock base, while a causeway with four 18‑metre piles bridges the soft clay of the east bank.
Named after Launceston businessman John Batman, the bridge links the Batman Highway to both the West Tamar Highway (A7) and East Tamar Highway (A8), overlooking the Deviot Sailing Club.
